relation.rationale: Corrects adversarially demonstrated scientific and validation-integrity gaps in the Gate A 1.1.2 packet while preserving the repository scope boundary and the proposed mission.

scope.objective: Specify and publicly distribute an offline, evidence-bound architecture and deterministic evaluation contract without implementing product behavior.
scope.unit_of_analysis: A versioned person-vehicle-automation encounter with object-level records and declared dependence structure.

estimands.target_population: The protocol-versioned target encounter population and object relevance frame.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Encounter-object-time tuple with clustered uncertainty at the preregistered level.
estimands.exposure: Observed object-level latent-belief distribution from the declared inference specification.
estimands.comparator: Exact protocol-named reference belief method or preregistered baseline; none is assumed by Gate A.
estimands.outcome: Proper-scoring-rule loss against a valid independently specified object reference state.
estimands.aggregation: Population mean loss conditional on valid observed belief and reference, paired with coverage.
identification_assumptions: Reference state validity and independence are established.
Object identity and temporal correspondence follow fixed rules.
validity_conditions: Belief components correspond to the declared state space and sum to one within tolerance.
Selective abstention and all non-observed states remain in coverage accounting.
estimands.abstention_rule: No score is imputed for abstention; report risk with coverage and counts by epistemic state.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister a cluster-aware interval or bound before observing outcomes.

estimands.target_population: The declared encounter population at an index time and readiness horizon h.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Encounter at index time with retained component capabilities.
estimands.exposure: A protocol-defined driver-vehicle-automation state; Gate A assumes no operational intervention.
estimands.comparator: Exact threshold, baseline method, or policy version named in a future accepted protocol.
estimands.outcome: Whether every required readiness capability meets its declared criterion within the validity boundary.
estimands.aggregation: Proportion meeting threshold among valid observed records, paired with readiness coverage and sensitivity bounds.
identification_assumptions: Capability definitions, threshold, horizon, and automation context are fixed before analysis.
validity_conditions: Every safety-critical component is valid and observed.
No aggregate score compensates for or hides a required unknown component.
estimands.abstention_rule: Any required abstained or otherwise non-observed component makes readiness non-observed under that state.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister an encounter-dependence-aware interval and non-observed-case sensitivity bounds.
required_reporting: coverage and counts for every component state

estimands.target_population: Valid preregistered challenge encounters with independently defined feasible recovery windows.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Challenge encounter, accounting for repeated persons or vehicles.
estimands.exposure: Exact assigned and received policy levels, recorded separately.
estimands.comparator: A versioned policy or control condition named before execution.
estimands.outcome: Recovery to a preregistered condition within horizon h, with explicit censoring.
estimands.aggregation: Cumulative recovery probability or other preregistered time-to-event functional.
identification_assumptions: Challenge onset and feasible window are defined independently of observed response.
Censoring and competing-event assumptions support the chosen estimator.
validity_conditions: Recovery sensors and outcome window pass declared checks.
No recovery inside a fully observed valid window is distinct from missing or invalid measurement.
estimands.abstention_rule: Invalid or unobserved recovery windows remain explicit and do not count as zero-time or no recovery.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister a dependence-aware survival interval or partial-identification bound.

estimands.target_population: Relevant encounter-object-time tuples established by a valid independent reference process.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Relevant encounter-object-time tuple with encounter-level clustering.
estimands.exposure: Concurrent human-side, automation-side, and fallback indication processes.
estimands.comparator: Exact human-only, automation-only, fallback, or policy configuration named in the protocol.
estimands.outcome: Joint absence of qualifying human, automation, and fallback indication within the fixed window.
estimands.aggregation: Probability of joint silent miss conditional on a valid relevant condition.
identification_assumptions: Reference relevance is independent enough for the declared interpretation.
Object correspondence and temporal tolerance are fixed before analysis.
validity_conditions: Human, automation, fallback, and reference operands are all valid and observed.
Unknown operands make the joint event unknown rather than false.
estimands.abstention_rule: An abstention by any required operand remains abstained and is reported separately from no miss.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister a clustered interval and sensitivity analysis for non-observed operands.

estimands.target_population: A protocol-defined population satisfying the causal design's sampling and positivity boundaries.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Assigned unit with interference clusters declared before assignment.
estimands.exposure: Well-defined versioned policy pi_1, including assignment, delivery, receipt, and adherence.
estimands.comparator: Well-defined versioned policy pi_0 with the same treatment-version detail.
estimands.outcome: A fixed post-index outcome over a fixed horizon without post-hoc relabeling.
estimands.aggregation: Average potential-outcome contrast or another explicitly named causal contrast.
identification_assumptions: Consistency, positivity, exchangeability or valid randomization, and declared interference hold.
Outcome and censoring processes meet the preregistered identification requirements.
validity_conditions: Policy versions and contamination are recorded.
No unsupported conditioning on post-treatment variables occurs.
estimands.abstention_rule: Unsupported required assumptions yield an inconclusive or invalid identification disposition, not an unqualified effect.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister design-consistent uncertainty and assumption sensitivity or bounds.
required_reporting: effect contrast with uncertainty or bounds

estimands.target_population: The exact retained trajectory-history population under frozen behavior and target policy versions and a fixed horizon.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Trajectory with its ordered, history-local decision steps and declared dependence structure.
estimands.exposure: The frozen target-policy action distribution at each retained pre-action information history.
estimands.comparator: The frozen behavior policy that generated each logged action and propensity.
estimands.outcome: The reward sequence under one exact reward contract, discounted through the fixed terminal or maximum horizon.
estimands.aggregation: Expected discounted target-policy return; Gate A validates its operands and authorizes no policy-value output.
identification_assumptions: Sequential consistency and history-local support hold for every target-positive action.
The reward contract, horizon, discount factor, termination rule, and policy versions are fixed before outcome access.
validity_conditions: Behavior and target distributions, logged propensities, cumulative weights, support cells, and horizon-specific effective sample sizes are internally consistent.
Estimator selection is outcome blind and missing or unsupported operands remain explicit rather than extrapolated.
estimands.abstention_rule: An unsupported history-action cell, undefined weight construction, or required non-observed reward blocks a policy-value result rather than producing an extrapolated estimate.
estimands.uncertainty_method: A future accepted protocol must preregister estimator-specific, trajectory-aware uncertainty and support sensitivity before outcomes are accessed.
required_reporting: policy, action-space, reward, horizon, and weight-contract versions
support cells and effective sample size at every horizon
outcome-blind estimator selection and explicit no-output disposition at Gate A

estimands.target_population: The exact declared conformal test population and complete preregistered group set.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Evaluated prediction set paired with one valid reference outcome and retained group membership.
estimands.exposure: A fixed conformal method, calibration split, test split, and miscoverage level alpha.
estimands.comparator: The exact coverage constraint one minus alpha, not an unconstrained scalar optimization target.
estimands.outcome: Whether the valid reference outcome belongs to the corresponding prediction set.
estimands.aggregation: Covered reference outcomes divided by evaluated outcomes for the marginal population and every declared group.
identification_assumptions: Calibration and test split integrity is retained and any exchangeability basis for a guarantee is independently supported.
The method, alpha, target, population, group universe, and reference process are fixed before evaluation.
validity_conditions: Target coverage equals one minus alpha and group results cover the declared universe exactly once.
No finite-sample guarantee is asserted without eligible exchangeability evidence; prediction-set efficiency is outside this Gate A estimand.
estimands.abstention_rule: A non-observed prediction set, reference outcome, or required group result remains explicit and cannot be counted as covered or uncovered.
estimands.uncertainty_method: A future accepted protocol must preregister marginal and simultaneous group-aware coverage uncertainty without converting the target constraint into a scalar ranking.
required_reporting: alpha, target coverage, method, calibration set, and test set versions
marginal and complete group coverage with sample counts and epistemic dispositions
guarantee kind, scope, exchangeability disposition, and explicit efficiency boundary

estimands.target_population: The exact common evaluation population governed by the frozen OOD reference, detector, and selective threshold rules.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Evaluation row with explicit reference, detector, and selective disposition states.
estimands.exposure: The frozen OOD detector and selective acceptance rule at one declared operating point.
estimands.comparator: A Pareto operating-point comparison with no hidden scalarization across detection, risk, and coverage components.
estimands.outcome: The vector of true-positive rate, false-positive rate, accepted error risk, and selective coverage, with prevalence and unknown mass retained separately.
estimands.aggregation: Exact disjoint OOD reference-by-detector cells and an exhaustive selective partition over the same population.
identification_assumptions: The OOD reference process is valid for its declared scope and the OOD and selective sections cover the same fixed population.
Detector and selection rules are frozen before evaluation and every derived rate uses its declared denominator.
validity_conditions: The nine OOD cells and seven selective states are exhaustive, disjoint, and arithmetically consistent with every reported count and rate.
Unknown reference or detector mass remains explicit, prevalence remains descriptive, and no scalar ranking is inferred from the vector.
estimands.abstention_rule: Unknown, invalid, abstained, or otherwise non-observed rows remain in their exact partition states and cannot be coerced into accepted, in-distribution, or error-free outcomes.
estimands.uncertainty_method: A future accepted protocol must preregister joint uncertainty for the rate vector and any Pareto comparison while retaining cross-component dependence.
required_reporting: the complete OOD cell table, unknown counts, denominators, true-positive rate, false-positive rate, and descriptive prevalence
the complete selective partition, accepted errors, accepted risk, coverage, and threshold chronology
the unsimplified rate vector and explicit no-scalarization disposition

estimands.target_population: A named, versioned target domain with retained target-domain evidence.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: The same unit definition in source and target domains or an explicit harmonization mapping.
estimands.exposure: A fixed method version evaluated without undisclosed target tuning.
estimands.comparator: The same metric under a named source domain and any preregistered target baseline.
estimands.outcome: Target-domain metric and target-minus-source transfer gap.
estimands.aggregation: Domain-specific performance and gap, each paired with uncertainty and coverage.
identification_assumptions: Required support overlap and measurement invariance are established.
Adaptation data and target-domain tuning are fully disclosed.
validity_conditions: Source and target data, labels, protocols, and versions are retained.
Absent required overlap is out-of-distribution rather than extrapolated performance.
estimands.abstention_rule: Report target abstention and all other epistemic states; never infer target performance from source metadata alone.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister domain-aware intervals and overlap sensitivity analyses.
required_reporting: source metric, target metric, and transfer gap

estimands.target_population: The protocol target population partitioned by all preregistered groups and intersections.
estimands.unit_of_analysis: Protocol unit within each retained group, with cross-group dependence declared.
estimands.exposure: A fixed method or policy version common to the declared group comparison.
estimands.comparator: Exact baseline or policy version and metric direction fixed before group outcomes are examined.
estimands.outcome: Minimum group utility or maximum group loss across the full preregistered group set.
estimands.aggregation: Direction-aware extremum over group estimates without dropping low-information or non-observed groups.
identification_assumptions: Group construction is measured consistently and fixed before analysis.
Multiplicity and intersection policies match the declared decision rule.
validity_conditions: Every preregistered group appears with sample size, coverage, uncertainty, and information disposition.
Post-hoc groups are labeled exploratory and do not inherit preregistration.
estimands.abstention_rule: A group below the information criterion remains explicitly unknown or inconclusive and cannot be omitted from worst-group interpretation.
estimands.uncertainty_method: Preregister simultaneous or multiplicity-aware intervals and a minimum-information rule.
required_reporting: all group estimates, coverage, and uncertainty
worst-group identity or explicit unknown disposition

allowed: immutable repository snapshots and platform-bound validation guards
public distribution of the hash-bound static candidate
